messages.subject: Props dsl feedback
parts:
Hi all,

If you have a few minutes, we'd really appreciate your thoughts on
https://github.com/rstudio/ggvis/issues/48 - it's proposes a fairly
major change to the props syntax to make it more consistent, and to
support more unscaled properties.

Winston and I have been talking through so many options that it's now
hard to objectively compare them.

Hadley

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Props dsl feedback
parts:
Hi everyone,

We've gone with option 5:

scaled expr: x = ~mpg
scaled cnst: x = 1
scaled rctv: x = input_slider()
unscld expr: fill := ~col
unscld cnst: fill := "red"
unscld rctv: fill := input_slider()
prop obj : y = prop(...)

It's a little more verbose than before, but it's more consistent, and
really forces you to confront whether you're dealing with scaled
values or raw values.

Hadley
